page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 64 dedicated physical cores using the Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio, each of the 64 vCPUs maps directly to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource contention typically associated with hyperthreading.

The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no onboard GPUs.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and large memory footprint position this instance for resource-intensive enterprise workloads. The absence of local storage and GPUs makes it a specialized choice for memory-bound tasks rather than storage-heavy or graphics-accelerated processing. It is suited for workloads such as large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, heavy caching layers, and complex data analytics pipelines.
